No option can be put forward yet, because the model could not test your under‑4% monthly churn limit.

- The price comparison itself held up under the changes tested, but that is not a finding that any option meets both of your stated conditions.
- The £20k MRR threshold was also not scored: the model lacks a recorded MRR baseline and does not specify whether the target is a level or change; its direction was assumed as “higher”.
- Pro subscriber count is the strongest modelled driver, but it is Olumi’s provisional estimate, not user evidence.

The key next reasoning step is to attach the churn limit to a directly measured part of the model.
